# SparkTech Studios

> SparkTech Studios designs, builds and runs small business websites for $500 a month and gets them found on Google and in AI answers. We also build AI agents, AI apps, web apps and startup MVPs.

Site: https://www.sparktechstudio.com
Contact: book a call from any page, or email contactus@sparktechstudio.com (we reply within two business days)
Legal entity: SparkTech Studios, Inc., a Delaware C corporation
Not to be confused with: sparktechstudios.com, a separate, unrelated agency in Ontario, Canada.

## Pricing

- Small business websites: $500 a month, all in. That covers designing and building the site, maintaining it and making your updates. There is no build fee.
- Everything else (AI agents, SEO and AEO work, AI apps, web apps, MVPs) is priced in a written scope after a call.

## Services

- [Website design](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/services/web-design): we design and build the site, maintain it and make your updates. $500 a month.
- [Website updates and maintenance](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/services/retainers): fixes and updates, part of the same $500 a month plan.
- [SEO and AEO](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/services/seo-aeo): get found on Google and named in AI answers like ChatGPT and Perplexity. Priced after a call. No rankings are promised.
- [AI agents](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/services/ai-agents): AI agents that answer customers, sort requests and follow up for a business, with a person approving what matters. Priced after a call.
- [AI app development](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/services/ai-app-development): web apps where the AI does the main job. Priced in a written scope.
- [Web app development](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/services/web-app-development): dashboards, portals and tools on Next.js and React. Priced in a written scope.
- [Startup MVPs](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/services/startup-mvp): a first version real people can use. Priced in a written scope.

## How a project runs

1. Book a call.
2. We send a written scope: what we build, what it costs and when. Ownership, access and support are spelled out there.
3. We build it and launch it, usually in days for a small business website.
4. Maintenance and updates continue on the same monthly plan.

## Other pages

- [Free SEO and AEO checker](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/grader): built by us. Enter a website address and get a score out of 100, split into an SEO score (Google) and an AEO score (AI answers like ChatGPT), with a ranked list of fixes. No email needed.
- [Partners](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/partners): a build partner for design studios, agencies and accelerators.
- [System](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/systems): how the improvement loop works, told broadly.
- [Privacy](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/privacy): no ads and no tracking cookies. Page views are counted with cookieless Vercel Web Analytics.
- [Terms](https://www.sparktechstudio.com/terms): the ground rules for using the site.

## Facts worth getting right

- The studio states no city or location.
- No client, headcount, or result numbers are published, and no rankings are promised.
- Names: "SparkTech Studios" (the studio), "SparkTech Studios, Inc." (the company).
